name: Ahmed R.
text: Best gulab jamun in Vehari, hands down. My family orders a box every Friday for weekend chai. Fresh, soft, and perfectly sweet.

name: Fatima K.
text: We got our wedding mithai boxes from Tohfa Sweets and every guest complimented the quality. The packaging was beautiful too. Highly recommend for events!

name: Usman T.
text: Good bakery items, especially the cream rolls and patties. The cafe food is decent too. Chai is excellent. Could improve the seating area though.

name: Ayesha M.
text: Ordered a red velvet cake for my daughter's birthday and it was stunning! Tasted as good as it looked. Delivery was on time. Will order again.

name: Bilal S.
text: The biryani is really flavourful and the portion size is generous. Naan is always fresh from the tandoor. A great spot for a quick lunch in Karkhana Bazar.

name: Sana A.
text: Lovely sweets and the staff is friendly. The drive-through is really convenient when I'm picking up kids from school. Jalebi is always crispy and fresh.
